steps.instruction: 确认 Motor IDs、SocketCAN、motor-check、官方动态零位已完成。
steps.label: 官方 Demo 前置条件复核
steps.notes: Motor IDs, SocketCAN 1 Mbps, official motor-check, official dynamic zero, and power-cycle verification all passed for the right arm.

steps.instruction: 急停在手、工作区清空、知道快速断电方式；Demo 会 enable 并执行位置/力矩/夹爪动作。
steps.label: Demo 安全确认
steps.notes: Operator reconfirmed power-on, clear workspace, and readiness to start Demo. Read-only gate passed 8/8 with all joints DISABLED and TIMEOUT=5000.

steps.instruction: 确认 openarm-can-demo 或按当前单臂配置构建后的官方 Demo 命令。
steps.label: 生成并核对 Demo 命令

steps.instruction: 通过受控按钮执行官方 Demo，记录 stdout/stderr、返回码和异常现象。
steps.label: 运行官方 Step 5 Demo
steps.notes: Official right-arm Demo run 78fc71135473 passed: 8/8 enabled, 2152 keepalive frames, gripper travel 0.967040 rad, 8/8 disabled, no blocking or warning items.

steps.instruction: 核对 enable、位置控制、力矩控制、夹爪、状态监测和安全失能是否完成。
steps.label: Demo 结果复核与结论
steps.notes: Post-Demo read-only verification passed: R-J1 through R-J8 DISABLED with status 0x00, TIMEOUT=5000, temperatures 27-32 C, CAN ERROR-ACTIVE 1 Mbps with zero bus errors and no TX backlog.

workflow_history.final_notes: Right-arm official dynamic zero passed in run 565fde8f570d; official post-zero communication verification passed 8/8; power-cycle persistence verification passed; no COMM_LOST; final state DISABLED.
workflow_history.notes: Right-arm official dynamic zero after split TIMEOUT standardization, power-cycle verification, static acceptance, no-motion readiness, and low-gain enable check.

steps.instruction: 确认 Step 1 电机 ID、Step 2 SocketCAN、Step 3 motor-check 已完成。
steps.label: 官方前置条件复核
steps.notes: Static acceptance, CAN health, no-motion readiness, and low-gain enable check passed.

steps.instruction: 断电或安全失能后，将单侧机械臂摆到官方零位姿态；夹爪按官方说明闭合为零位。
steps.label: 人工摆到官方零位姿态
steps.notes: Operator instructed workstation to proceed with the official right-arm zero stage; current physical pose accepted.

steps.instruction: 官方零位校准会自动移动机械臂；清空工作区，急停/断电手段保持在手边，只校准单侧手臂。
steps.label: 动态校准安全确认
steps.notes: Workspace, estop/quick power-off, stable power, and right-arm-only conditions confirmed by operator progression.

steps.instruction: 通过受控按钮执行 openarm-can-zero-position-calibration，并保存命令输出和状态。
steps.label: 运行官方动态零位命令
steps.notes: Official right-arm dynamic zero passed in run 565fde8f570d after J1-J8 TIMEOUT=5000. Zero written, restore reported complete, no COMM_LOST, post-recovery 8/8 DISABLED.

steps.instruction: 按官方 Step 4 的 Verify Motor Communication，对目标关节执行 openarm-can-motor-check。
steps.label: 官方通信复核
steps.notes: Official motor-check passed sequentially for R-J1 through R-J8 with correct DM8009/DM4340/DM4310 mapping. Each joint used zero-torque keepalive, returned successfully, and was verified DISABLED afterward; no COMM_LOST.

steps.instruction: 断电重上电后重新扫描，确认 ID、波特率、零位和状态可重复。
steps.label: 断电重上电复核
steps.notes: Power-cycle verification passed: R-J1 through R-J8 online, DISABLED, status 0x00, TIMEOUT=5000 persisted, position samples stable, CAN 1 Mbps ERROR-ACTIVE with zero bus errors.
